head.title: Seasons and waves
head.subtitle: The season, its eight monitoring waves per grade, reminders to parents, and the schools list. Times are Tashkent time.

states.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this section
states.noAccessBody: Seasons, waves and schools are managed by the season manager only. Ask an administrator if you need access.
states.errBody: The server didn’t answer. Nothing was changed — try again in a moment.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.sub: Exactly one season is current. Parents see the waves of the current season only.
seasons.emptyBody: Create the first season, then set its waves for each grade.
seasons.datesErr: The end must be after the start.
seasons.makeCurrentHint: Parents’ wave lists switch to this season straight away. Leave it off to prepare a season in advance.
seasons.currentBody: Only one season can be current. Switching changes what every family sees right away:
currentList: Parents’ wave lists show the waves of {code} only.
{old} stops being current; its waves and results stay as they are.
Waves that are open now in {old} stay open until they close.

cal.title: Wave calendar · {code}
cal.sub: Eight windows per grade. A wave can be taken only when a frozen monitoring form is attached. Windows of one grade can’t overlap.
cal.notCurrent: This season isn’t current: parents don’t see these waves yet.
cal.noSeasonBody: Create a season above — its calendar appears here.
cal.noForm: No form yet — can’t be taken

wave.formsEmpty: There’s no frozen monitoring form for this grade yet. The bank editor builds and freezes one in Forms; until then the wave can be scheduled but not taken.
wave.noFormWarn: Without a form children can’t start this wave. You can attach it later, until the wave opens.
wave.openNote: This wave is open. Its start and its form are history — children have already started with them — so the only change left is giving more time: move the close later.
wave.closesErr: The close must be after the opening.
wave.extendErr: An open wave can only be extended: pick a later close.
wave.dateErr: Fill in both date and time.

remind.btnLong: Remind parents who haven’t taken it
remind.title: Remind parents about wave {n} · {grade}?
remind.body: A Telegram reminder goes out for every child of this grade who hasn’t submitted the wave yet. The rules:
list: Only to the child’s owner — never to a child, never to co-guardians or educators.
At most one reminder per child per day; children already reminded today are skipped.
Only children whose data-processing consent is in force.
remind.doneFmt: {queued} queued · {throttled} already reminded today · {eligible} haven’t taken it
remind.announceFmt: Reminders for wave {n}: {queued} queued, {throttled} already reminded today

schools.title: Schools
schools.sub: The schools parents choose from when they add a child. Pupils = children enrolled this year.
schools.chooseBody: Schools are listed per region. Pick one to see and edit its schools.
schools.emptyTitle: No schools in this region yet
schools.emptyBody: Add the first one — parents will see it straight away.
schools.emptyQBody: Check the spelling, or clear the search.
schools.regionFixed: A school’s region never changes: enrolments and cohorts are counted by it. If a school was added in the wrong region, add it again in the right one.

errors.SEASON_EXISTS: A season with this code already exists.
errors.SEASON_WINDOW: The season’s end must be after its start.
errors.WAVE_OVERLAP: Windows of one grade can’t overlap. Move this window so it doesn’t touch another wave of the same grade.
errors.WAVE_WINDOW: The window doesn’t fit: the close must be after the opening.
errors.WAVE_STARTED: This wave is already open: its start and form can’t change any more — only the close can move later.
errors.WAVE_CLOSED: This wave is closed and can’t be changed.
errors.WAVE_FORM_INVALID: This form can’t be used: it must be a frozen monitoring form of the same grade.
errors.WAVE_EXISTS: This wave already exists — refresh the page.
errors.WAVE_NOT_OPEN: Reminders can be sent only while the wave is open.
errors.NO_SEASON: There is no season to put this wave in.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have the right to do this.
errors.VALIDATION: Some fields aren’t filled in correctly.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
